::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--id`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
ID of the sample.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"foo"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--input`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
The fastq.gz files to align. Can also be a single directory containing fastq.gz files.

Individual FASTQ files should follow the naming convention of 10x Genomics:
[Sample Name]_S[Sample Number]_L[Lane Number]_[Read Type]_001.fastq.gz

Where:
[Sample Name] is the name assigned during sample preparation/sequencing
S[Sample Number] is the sample index (usually S1, S2, etc.)
L[Lane Number] identifies the sequencing lane (L001, L002, etc.)

[Read Type] will be one of:
R1 - Read 1 (contains the spatial barcode and UMI)
R2 - Read 2 (contains the actual cDNA sequence)
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `file` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"sample_S1_L001_R1_001.fastq.gz"`, `"sample_S1_L001_R2_001.fastq.gz"`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--gex_reference`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Path of folder containing 10x-compatible reference
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"/path/to/refdata-gex-GRCh38-2020-A"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--probe_set`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
CSV file specifying the probe set used
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"Visium_Human_Transcriptome_Probe_Set_v2.0_GRCh38-2020-A.csv"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--cytaimage`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Brightfield image generated by the CytAssist instrument.
When using CytAssist workflow, either this or --image must be provided.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"cyta_image.tif"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--image`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
H&E or fluorescence microscope image in TIFF or JPG format.
Required for standard Visium workflow, optional when using --cytaimage for CytAssist workflow.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"brightfield.tif"`
:::
::::
:::::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_spatial \
  -r v0.5.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/workflows/ingestion/spaceranger_mapping/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline_spatial/v0.5.0/components/workflows/ingestion/spaceranger_mapping);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_spatial \
  -r v0.5.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/workflows/ingestion/spaceranger_mapping/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
